register.labelZh: MUDDLE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: muddle along 和 muddle on 可以描述某人、家庭或組織雖然安排不完善,仍然勉強繼續下去。；muddle through 適合用來描述某人在知識、準備或協助不足的情況下,仍勉強完成或渡過難關。；muddle somebody up 表示令某人感到混亂;muddle A up with B 則表示把一個人或事物錯當成另一個。；muddle something up with something 可以描述文件、衣物、金錢或其他物品被雜亂無章地混在一起。
register.summaryEn: Muddle along and muddle on describe people, families or organisations that keep going even though their situation is not well organised. Muddle through is useful when someone completes or survives a difficult situation without enough knowledge, preparation or help. Muddle somebody up means making a person confused. Muddle A up with B means mistaking one person or thing for another. Muddle something up with something can describe papers, clothes, money or other objects that have been mixed together without order.
